Privacy notice

How Daily Letter uses your information

Last updated: September 15, 2026.

Information you provide

If you create a Player ID, Daily Letter stores the information you enter: your name, username, email address, age, phone number, street address, city, state and ZIP code. Your password is stored only as a one-way password hash.

Game and technical information

We store account login sessions, puzzle results, streaks and game statistics needed to provide the service. Basic hosting and security logs may include device, browser, request and IP-address information.

Why we use this information

We use it to create and maintain player accounts, authenticate sign-ins, save game results, calculate statistics and rankings, secure the service, respond to requests and operate Daily Letter.

Advertising and external links

Clearly labeled advertising areas may link to third-party websites. Those websites have their own privacy practices. Daily Letter does not promise prizes, cash rewards or guaranteed outcomes.

Security and retention

Passwords use one-way hashing and login sessions use secure, HttpOnly cookies. We retain account information while an account is active or as reasonably needed to operate, secure and comply with legal obligations.

Your choices

Creating a Player ID is optional. You may play without creating an account. To request access, correction or deletion of information associated with your account, use our contact form.

Contact

Questions about this notice or your information can be submitted through the Daily Letter contact page.
